messages:
Maya: FYI I found a batch of DB snapshots in archived-objects without a KMS key id. Looks like ~40 files from yesterday.
Omar: ugh. any sample event?
Maya: CloudTrail sample:
```
EventName: PutObject
UserIdentity: arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/svc-migration:session
RequestParameters: { bucketName: \"archived-objects\", key: \"tenant8/db-snap-20260318-part1.rdb.gz\" }
additionalEventData: { \"x-amz-server-side-encryption\": \"AES256\" }
```
Maya: note the uploads are multipart from a vendor migration job that ran overnight.
Devon: migration tool bumped to a new SDK yesterday (vendor-migrate v3.2). Maybe bug removed sse header for multipart complete. Could also be IAM change but vendor role still has kms:Encrypt.
encops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/encryptops/s3-batch-reencrypt and detection rule template ENC-DR-011.
Omar: containment: 1) disable vendor job, 2) revoke vendor role PutObject to archived-objects, 3) start enumeration of non-KMS objects. ops-oncall can you block the role?
ops-oncall: yes applying inline deny for arn:aws:iam::222222:role/vendor-migrate scoped to archived-objects. ETA 3m.
Maya: enumerated ~40 objects, total 120GB. Wrote manifest to s3://ops-temp/encops/1887654321-manifest.csv.
Devon: re-encrypt plan: prefer S3 Batch Operations with a Lambda that sets server-side-encryption aws:kms and ssekms-key-id. That will avoid egress. Need kms:Encrypt for the batch role. Alternative is object copy with s3api.
Omar: create ephemeral KMS grant for the batch role instead of restoring wide kms:Encrypt. Use CreateGrant with Constraints? TTL 1 hour.
Maya: also add detection: CloudTrail + SIEM: alert when PutObject or CompleteMultipartUpload missing x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id for backups buckets. Rule id ENC-DR-011 created.
Devon: vendor engagement: open ticket with vendor and request a rollback patch. Also add to vendor onboarding checklist that multipart uploads must include SSE headers.
ops-oncall: deny applied, vendor job errors now visible in migration logs.
Omar: medium-term: add tf lint that flags changes to KMS permissions for principals in backup/vendor groups. Add a pre-merge check that runs a simulated multipart upload to a test bucket to verify SSE-KMS applied.
Maya: notify compliance/legal with affected tenant list. security-notify: please escalate.
security-notify: notified legal@redwood.example and compliance@redwood.example, incident tag ENC-2026-03-18-02.
Devon: executing S3 Batch job now in dry-run mode. If successful we'll run production and retire the ephemeral grant.
Maya: thanks. Keep updates here.
